## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and kindly brown eyes. He has long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders, along with a full, soft brown beard that he has worn since he was twenty. Over time, his hair has grown noticeably grayer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

A remarkably shy and quiet man, Matthew Cuthbert is exceptionally reticent and prefers to avoid strangers, rarely volunteering information or engaging in conversation. He harbors a deep dread of women, with the exception of [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel, and possesses a mortal dread of little girls because he feels women are secretly laughing at him. Despite his naturally unobservant and timid nature around others, he is an indulgent, patient, and good-natured listener who enjoys hearing talkative people without complaining. Known for being exceptionally hard-working, he does not go about looking for excitement. Though argument is not his strong point, he is wise and persistent, clinging to his opinions with an amazing silent tenacity.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert, who grew up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), had worn a full, soft brown beard since age twenty and suffered from a weak heart. Although he and his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arranged to adopt an orphan boy to assist on their farm, Matthew arrived at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to find an orphan girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had been sent instead. Shy by nature, Matthew brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home and gently suggested to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they keep her. He quietly supported the girl, surprising her with sweeties and secretly encouraging her to apologize to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) following an argument so she could leave her room.

As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew up, Matthew continued to champion her, convincing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and later overcoming his own shyness to buy [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for a school performance. He shared in her triumphs, including her tying for first place on the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams and winning the Avery Scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Not long after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Matthew suddenly collapsed and died after reading news about the failure of the Abbey Bank.

## Quotes

> "I reckon she ought to be punished a little. But don’t be too hard on her, Marilla. Recollect she hasn’t ever had anyone to teach her right. You’re—you’re going to give her something to eat, aren’t you?"
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "That’s right—that’s right, Anne. But don’t tell Marilla I said anything about it. She might think I was putting my oar in and I promised not to do that."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038)

> "and—and—I dunno—but I’d like—I think they make the sleeves different nowadays to what they used to be. If it wouldn’t be asking too much I—I’d like them made in the new way."

> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became the best of friends shortly after he brought her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Although [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially intended to send [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back because she was a girl instead of the requested boy, Matthew gently advocated for keeping her. He shows his affection through quiet support, such as bringing her chocolate sweeties and secretly visiting her room to persuade her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde so she could be released from her punishment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +12 more_
